text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clack... clack...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, they were supposed to be
training with Manhattan Cafe until just a moment ago—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Why is that in a place like this...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This place is—
a hazy dream, a fluctuation of time...
a place where thoughts twist and intertwine...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And now, 'something' is weeping in sorrow...
So powerfully, so plaintively that it keeps this train running...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Startled, I look out the window to find the night sky stretching endlessly.
It definitely doesn't seem to be the real world...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, the train had picked up speed...
Just where is it heading...?

text_block_list.name: Announcement?
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next stop, Keradabashi—
Keradabashi—’"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Unfamiliar place names are surely manifestations of wishes...
Something that 'someone' yearns for endlessly...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Ponder deeply upon the place names...
and decide whether to disembark or not..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If we do that, surely that 'something' will—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*snap*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Manhattan Cafe's tone grew serious, the voice cut out, and the train screeched to a halt.
Outside the window lay an uphill slope, dirt, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe said, "Ponder the place names carefully...
and decide whether to disembark or not." In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The place name 'Keradabashi'...
Could it be...? Acting on a hunch,
I decided to get off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then—
unlike moments before, the ground felt solid beneath my feet.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
So this is where you were...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...?
What on earth is that white thing...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spun around in a panic, and just as she said,
something like a white mist was rising into the air.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I see, Keradabashi—
read backwards, it's "shiba darake" (covered in turf).

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It seems the "something" in the dream wanted to come
here once more together with someone.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And now, that wish has been granted...
Farewell—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A white mist sparkles as it fades into the sky.
Having fulfilled its wish, "that something" seems to have vanished.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Today... I feel like I've once again
experienced just how kind you are, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... You accept the existence
of things unseen...
And you listen to their voices...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the only one being saved...
That much was made crystal clear to me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I felt a true sense of kindness in her actions—connecting with the mysterious and giving voice to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Feeling that I shouldn't get off just yet,
I decided to stay on board.
The train begins to move once more—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clack... clack...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(—*clatter-clatter, clatter-clatter*)
(—*clatter-clatter, clatter-clatter*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is it just my imagination...?
I feel like the train is speeding up even more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(—*clatter-clatter, clatter-clatter!!*)
(—*clatter-clatter, clatter-clatter!!*)
(—*clatter-clatter, clatter-clatter!!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The moment I thought things looked bad,
I felt as if I were being shoved aside.
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*tap-tap-tap-tap—!!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, it was rolling across the central plaza, and a student just happened to be running right towards it...!
At this rate—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Just in the nick of time.
Manhattan Cafe rushed over
and saved me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that happened in your dream...
Keradabashi—
read backwards, it's "shiba darake" (covered in turf).

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It seems the "something" in the dream wants to visit
that place once more together with someone.
...Let's go and see.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, I knew it. You really wanted to come here, didn't you...?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
May you find peace, if even for the briefest of moments...
Farewell—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something like a white mist rises,
sparkling as it fades into the sky...
Having fulfilled its wish, "that something" seems to have vanished.
choice_data_list: You really understood my wish, huh?
You really understood my wish, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: They're weak, and they disappear so quickly...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Before they transiently scatter and fade—I want to be by their side as much as I can...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From those words, one could feel her kindness
as she tried to reach out to the mysterious.
